bootstrap.method: stratified seed-cluster percentile bootstrap; all four seats and all policies resampled together
bootstrap.canonicalOrder: seed, seat, requested policy order; strata ordered by their first seed

multiplicity.pairs: 95% exploratory intervals; no simultaneous adjustment across all policy pairs
multiplicity.improvements: 99.1666667% marginal percentile intervals: Bonferroni for six predeclared version-minus-parent comparisons, targeting 95% family coverage
multiplicity.profiles: 95% exploratory intervals; no simultaneous subgroup adjustment

bootstrap.rankDefinition: competition rank within each game; topScore includes tied first places
